title: Market rebalance: tighter town, fair Handcart, better apples
problem: REP-025 and REP-027: undercutting and dumping old stock dominate (43% and 51% wins against a fair 33%), premium pricing is nearly hopeless (13%), apples are a trap, early leaders snowball and 4-player games are starved. Lab tests on held-out seeds show the package below fixes these without faster decay or spoilage quotas.
scope: E1 src/engine/data.ts + game.ts: demand 0.6 + 0.45 x progress (was 0.4 + 0.45); deliveries 0.8 + 0.2 x progress (was 1 + 0.5)
E2 game.ts: demand and deliveries sized from players x 4 (marketCapacity), not from upgraded buy limits
E4 data.ts: apple cost fresh 3, okay 2, not so 1 (was 4, 3, 1); new apple theme line
E5 protocol.ts RULES_VERSION 3; worker.ts daily board key includes the rules version; RULES.md, Handcart text and balance notes updated; new unit tests
AI: no code change expected (reads demand and costs at run time); re-measured after the patch
exclusions: Decay curves, traits, mango, delivery forecast, Juice Press, Cool Room, league stages, achievements thresholds (optional follow-ups in REP-027 section 6b)
Telemetry or any new data collection
